title: Can You Find Something Red?
description:
Can You Find Something Red? Red! This is my friend Red.
A quick colors, shapes and counting Short for toddlers and preschoolers ages 1–5, with Bloop the jelly blob.

Red! This is my friend Red. An apple is red. A ball can be red. A heart is red, too! Can you find something red around you? Point to it!
